title: Binary Searchable Numbers in an Unsorted Array
goal: Count values guaranteed to be found by binary search despite the array being unsorted.
strategy: A value is safe exactly when all values to its left are smaller and all values to its right are larger. Prefix maxima and suffix minima certify both sides.
